title: Finding a percent of a quantity

blocks.content: Finding a percent of an amount comes up everywhere — sales, scores, tips. A few friendly percents have quick shortcuts.
50% is a half (divide by 2), and 10% is a tenth (divide by 10).

blocks.explain: 50% is a half, and half of 40 is 20.
blocks.rule: 50% of a number is half of it; 10% is a tenth of it.
25% of a number is a quarter of it (divide by 4).

blocks.content: 50% halve it, 25% quarter it, 10% divide by ten. Learn the shortcuts and percents become easy. Let's practise!
